purpose: Teach: コレクター/木工/かなえ/ロマンス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、コレクター、絶対、のお客様、絶対、来てくれたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A regular customer who collects things came in today.
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Open attack on the first syllable. Conversational pace, lean forward slightly with genuine delight at having something to share.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、木工、絶対、教室、絶対、通ってみようかな、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking maybe I should try that woodworking class.
lines.style: Tentative but warming. Soft opening. Pause before the commitment word, testing the idea aloud for the first time. Slight lift at the end—inviting response, not closed off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、かなえ、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、お元気?メイちゃん
lines.en: How is Kanae doing these days?
lines.style: Genuine warmth with a thread of care underneath. Moderate pace, steady eye contact level. The kind of question that says you've been thinking about someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ロマンス、絶対、映画、絶対、新作、絶対、見たいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really want to see the new romance film when it comes out.
lines.style: Eager but grounded. Build slightly toward the want-word. Breath of anticipation on the opening. Ends with quiet conviction, not performative excitement.
